title: Latvia: Tunnels, Turbulence, and Taxpayer Risk · 15 Aug
keywords: Latvia, Belarus, border security, hybrid threat, illegal migration, airBaltic, airline bailout, state-owned enterprise, Latvia inflation, Eurostat, EU migration policy, Baltic security, taxpayer risk, national carrier, frontier defense
notes: Latvia is confronting two distinct but equally pressing challenges: an intensifying security standoff along its border with Belarus and a deepening financial crisis at state-controlled airline airBaltic. Both files carry significant consequences for public spending, civil liberties, and Latvia's standing within the European Union. The government's responses to each are being scrutinized by critics who question the transparency and long-term cost of its chosen remedies.
